newsitem.title: USA: Swift Energy 97 ups cap spending by 26 pct.
newsitem.headline: Swift Energy 97 ups cap spending by 26 pct.

text.p: Swift Energy Co said that it will increase its capital spending by 26 percent to $113 million, with $85 million of the budget allocated to exploration and development drilling.

The company also said that its year-end 1996 proved reserves of natural gas, crude oil, condensate and natural gas liquids rose 47 percent to a record of 259 billion cubic feet of natural gas equivalent (BCFE).
Swift said it will report fourth quarter earnings next week. Swift said all of its 120 BCFE in 1996 was from its successful drilling in Olmos Field and Austin Chalk Trend.
